title: Cannot get "moisture" in the air.  All I feel is the fan.
text:
Cannot get "moisture" in the air. All I feel is the fan.. I'm not too keen over this digital readout evaporative humidifier. I have tried it several times, and for one thing, I usually get a moist air from an evaporative humidifier, but even on high, I could not feel anything but cool, dry air. I was not getting any indication that it was a moisture air.

OK.... EDIT. I ran it again for the 5th time and I do believe it did shut off automatically.

But my issue is that I believe a evaporative cooler should put out "some" moisture, and I am not getting it on this one.
